research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AminoChain is engaged in developing systems for managing tokenized biospecimen transfers, as described in 'Transferring blockchain-based tokens representing biospecimens.' This work details a method where a biobank node retrieves donor-associated private data from a data provider’s database, integrating it with a blockchain network to facilitate secure and efficient transfer of biospecimens. The company’s research and development centers on blockchain-enabled management of stem cell tokenization and donor participation.

overview_description.description: AminoChain facilitates the handling of biosamples by linking data from healthcare companies. The platform enables users to manage bio-sample inventories, maintain ownership of their assets, and collaborate effectively. It offers an integrated solution for sample procurement, agreements, and payments within a single platform.
